claims.claim: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi drone launched toward Saudi Arabia's Mecca region and that the drone was destroyed on Friday morning.
claims.episode_span: intercepted a drone the Houthis launched toward the Mecca region
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia reports interception of Houthi drone targeting Mecca
claims.supporting_quote: The drone was “intercepted and destroyed” on Friday morning, coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki said in a social media post.

claims.claim: A Houthi spokesperson denied targeting Mecca or the surrounding region and said attacks remain focused on Saudi energy and military infrastructure.
claims.episode_span: denied targeting the Muslim holy city or the surrounding region
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia reports interception of Houthi drone targeting Mecca
claims.supporting_quote: A Houthi spokesperson denied targeting the Muslim holy city or surrounding region, reiterating that the group’s cross-border attacks remain strictly focused on Saudi energy and military infrastructure.

claims.claim: On Thursday the Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile fired toward the eastern region and two ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh.
claims.episode_span: two ballistic missiles launched toward the Saudi capital, Riyadh
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia reports interception of Houthi drone targeting Mecca
claims.supporting_quote: It later said two ballistic missiles launched towards the Saudi capital, Riyadh, were also intercepted and destroyed.

claims.claim: Pete Hegseth and Gilberto Teodoro Jr. met on October 28 and agreed to launch an alliance command and control modernization sprint.
claims.episode_span: agreed to launch an alliance command and control modernization sprint
claims.source_title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gilberto Teodoro Jr.
claims.supporting_quote: They agreed to launch an alliance command and control modernization sprint to enhance real-time bilateral coordination and strengthen alliance resilience.

claims.claim: Hegseth announced an increase in Department of War security cooperation funds for Philippine armed forces modernization and First Island Chain interoperability.
claims.episode_span: increase in the Department of War’s security cooperation funds
claims.source_title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gilberto Teodoro Jr.
claims.supporting_quote: Secretary Hegseth announced an increase in the Department of War’s security cooperation funds to accelerate the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ modernization and enhance interoperability along the First Island Chain.

claims.claim: Gilbert Teodoro said the Philippines needs to increase access by air and sea to Batanes and that a Taiwan contingency may affect Philippine waters and Batanes.
claims.episode_span: in any Taiwan contingency, Philippine waters and Batanes may be affected
claims.source_title: The Philippine archipelago on the front line of China’s territorial ambitions
claims.supporting_quote: “We realize that in the case of any Taiwan contingency, our waters and Batanes may be affected,” Mr. Teodoro told The Globe and Mail.

claims.claim: In June, 20 Tao people rowed nearly 200 kilometres from Taiwan’s Orchid Island to Batanes.
claims.episode_span: 20 Tao people rowed nearly 200 kilometres from Taiwan’s Orchid Island
claims.source_title: The Philippine archipelago on the front line of China’s territorial ambitions
claims.supporting_quote: In June, 20 Tao people squeezed into a narrow, 12-metre-long wooden boat, painted white and red, and set off on a journey that hadn’t been made in 300 years.

claims.claim: Novaya Gazeta editor Sergei Sokolov said on Friday the paper is ceasing to exist because Russian special services forced the editorial team to end its work, and that servers will be shut on November 9.
claims.episode_span: on November 9 the newsroom will turn off the lights
claims.source_title: Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta to close, citing pressure from ‘special services’
claims.supporting_quote: “Novaya Gazeta is ceasing to exist,” the editor-in-chief, Sergei Sokolov, said in a video statement published on YouTube on Friday.

claims.claim: Oleg Roldugin was arrested in April, charged with unlawful access to computerised information, pleaded not guilty, and is under house arrest extended until 10 November.
claims.episode_span: pleaded not guilty, according to the state RIA news agency
claims.source_title: Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta to close, citing pressure from ‘special services’
claims.supporting_quote: He pleaded not guilty, according to the state RIA news agency.

claims.claim: A helicopter carrying six people, including five pilgrims, crashed in Uttarakhand after taking off from Badrinath, and Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami said it crashed near Joshimath in Chamoli district.
claims.episode_span: a helicopter carrying six people, including five pilgrims, crashed
claims.source_title: Rescue operations on after Indian helicopter crashes in Himalayan state
claims.supporting_quote: A search for survivors is under way after a helicopter carrying six people, including five pilgrims, crashed in the northern Indian state of Uttarakhand, officials say.

claims.claim: UK house prices grew 0.5 percent in the year to October, the slowest pace in more than two years, with the average at £273,566, flat on the month and down from 0.8 percent in September, Nationwide said.
claims.episode_span: grew by an annual rate of just 0.5 percent in October
claims.source_title: UK house prices grow at slowest pace in two years as mortgage rates rise
claims.supporting_quote: The average price for a property in the UK stood at £273,566 in October, flat on the previous month and down from 0.8% in the year to September, according to the lender Nationwide.

claims.claim: The death toll from Spain's high-speed train collision rose to 69.
claims.episode_span: rose to 69 dead, with scores injured
claims.source_title: Spain demands answers as train disaster toll rises
claims.supporting_quote: Spain began demanding answers on Thursday after the toll from the country's second high-speed train collision this year rose to 69 people, with scores injured

claims.claim: Gulf crude exports averaged 24.6 million barrels per day in the week to October 18, and Brent briefly topped $117, up more than 60 percent from before the war, with 32 vessel incidents logged in October.
claims.episode_span: averaged 24.6 million barrels a day in the week to October 18
claims.source_title: Oil flows are up as Iran war turmoil eases. Why do prices keep rising?
claims.supporting_quote: Crude exports from the Gulf averaged 24.6 million barrels per day (bpd) in the week to October 18, exceeding the pre-war average, according to market intelligence firm Kpler.

claims.claim: The People's Bank of China revealed an overnight rate of 1.25 percent before a policy-anchor shift.
claims.episode_span: revealed an overnight rate of 1.25 percent before a policy-anchor shift
claims.source_title: PBOC reveals overnight rate at 1.25% before policy anchor shift
claims.supporting_quote: PBOC reveals overnight rate at 1.25% before policy anchor shift

claims.episode_span: Bayer won a trial over claims Roundup caused cancer in three women
claims.source_title: Bayer wins Roundup weedkiller cancer trial while awaiting settlement ruling
claims.supporting_quote: Bayer wins Roundup weedkiller cancer trial while awaiting settlement ruling

claims.claim: Kenyans are among those charged in an alleged scheme that used stolen identities to claim US student aid, described as a $130 million ghost student scam.
claims.episode_span: Kenyans are among those charged in an alleged $130 million US student-aid scheme
claims.source_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam
claims.supporting_quote: The alleged scheme used stolen identities to claim US student aid, with Kenyans among those charged.
